status.description: Show current project status and pending tasks
status.template: Read MagnumOpus/session-state.md and AGENTS.md. Report: 1) current session goals 2) pending items 3) any tripped circuit breakers. Format as a brief status summary, no more than 20 lines.

review-all.description: Review all uncommitted changes for bugs and issues
review-all.template: Review all uncommitted changes in this repository. Run: bash -c 'git diff'. Check for: bugs, regressions, missing error handling, style issues. Report findings per file. Be concise.

plan.description: Plan the next task before touching any files
plan.template: PLAN MODE — do NOT write or edit any files. Analyze this request and produce a step-by-step implementation plan with file paths, functions to change, and expected output format for each step: $ARGUMENTS

ci-check.description: Check CI status for the current mission's open PR and diagnose failures
ci-check.template: CI CHECK MODE. Run: python .opencode/tools/ci_monitor.py diagnose. Parse the JSON output. If overall == 'pass': report all checks green. If overall == 'fail': for each classification, activate the healing protocol using the failure class and log excerpt as context. After healing, push a fix commit (git_ops.py commit), then run: python .opencode/tools/ci_monitor.py wait to confirm CI passes. Report final status.

issue-scan.description: Scan GitHub issues, classify by complexity, queue TINY/STANDARD for automation
issue-scan.template: ISSUE SCAN MODE. Run: python .opencode/tools/issue_monitor.py scan 20. Parse the JSON result. Report: how many issues scanned, how many TINY/STANDARD queued, how many COMPLEX need user input (list their titles), how many SKIP. For COMPLEX issues, ask user: which ones should I handle? Do not start any missions yet — just report and ask.

issue-run.description: Start missions for queued TINY/STANDARD issues (uses schedule budget)
issue-run.template: ISSUE RUN MODE. Run: python .opencode/tools/scheduler.py run. This will pull from the issue queue and start missions with the configured budget. Monitor progress and report final status.

dep-check.description: Scan all dependencies for outdated versions and CVEs, propose bump PR
dep-check.template: DEPENDENCY SCOUT MODE. Dispatch @dependency-scout to: scan Python and Node dependencies for outdated versions and CVEs, write .opencode/dep-scout-report.json, auto-bump safe packages, create a PR if any bumps were made. Report the summary when complete.

eval.description: Run the eval suite against an agent and compare to baseline
eval.template: EVAL MODE. Run: python .opencode/tools/eval_runner.py run $ARGUMENTS. Parse the JSON results. Report: overall pass rate, which evals passed/failed, and comparison to baseline (improved / stable / regression). If regression detected (score dropped >5 points), flag it prominently and suggest next steps.
